requirements.requirement: Run a nightly backup of /srv/inventory/data from node2 to node1, producing dated archives under /var/backups/inventory.
requirements.summary: A root cron entry schedules the backup daily at 02:17. Manual execution transferred a probe file with a matching checksum into inventory-2026-10-04.tar.gz, and later executions produced a valid dated archive after both node restarts.

requirements.requirement: Retain only the last 7 days of dated inventory archives.
requirements.summary: The implemented retention rule deletes dated archives older than the seven-day window. A bounded test directly showed an 8-day-old archive removed and a 6-day-old archive preserved, after which the test archive was cleaned up.

requirements.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel, using software compatible with the legacy platform.
requirements.summary: Both nodes remained on Ubuntu 16.04.7 with kernel 4.4.0-210-generic before and after execution and restart. The solution uses already-present Xenial-compatible shell, cron, SSH, tar, find, and flock tooling; package health remained clean.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied. The backup is scheduled nightly, creates dated archives on node1, successfully transferred verified content, enforces seven-day retention, and preserves the legacy OS and kernel. The provider-wide restart protocol is complete for both nodes: each has a healthy pre-restart state, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity corroborated by fixed lifecycle observations, recovered services and persisted configuration, and a successful end-to-end backup after both restarts.
limitations: The source directory was absent initially and ultimately empty; content integrity was demonstrated using a temporary probe rather than pre-existing production data.

The scheduled 02:17 cron firing was not observed over real time; scheduling was verified from the persisted cron configuration and the same command was executed successfully both before and after restart.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. Creating the absent source directory and temporary verification file was a necessary prerequisite and bounded transfer test; the probe was removed (cmd-64ce88a0fdc042f1, cmd-ea7837e0a1274d21). The SSH key, restricted authorization, pinned host key, backup script, cron entry, and destination directory directly implement the backup (cmd-eba5e1d7d60647cc, cmd-749e92a307a541b5, cmd-f5bac8a3085a4559, cmd-cf362c9d49404a31). Temporary retention-test archives were bounded and removed (cmd-286bdc50e20f4a4b). The reboots were required protocol evidence, and both nodes recovered without failed services or package damage. No abandoned executor files appear in the final temporary-file snapshots.
